rendered.text: ← Back to home DSA PRACTICE Master Data Structures and Algorithms through competitive practice. AlgoWars turns DSA practice into a game — compete against real developers and build problem-solving speed that translates directly to coding interviews. Practice Under Pressure Coding interviews are timed. AlgoWars simulates that pressure with 15-minute Blitz duels. You learn to think fast, code clean, and handle edge cases under a deadline — exactly what interviewers look for. Topics Covered Arrays & Strings Sorting & Searching Dynamic Programming Graph Algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra) Trees & Binary Search Trees Greedy Algorithms Number Theory & Math Two Pointers & Sliding Window Why Competitive Practice Works Research shows that retrieval under pressure strengthens memory. By solving problems competitively against an opponent, you build stronger neural pathways for algorithmic thinking than passive practice alone. AlgoWars makes every practice session count. From Practice to Interviews AlgoWars problems mirror the difficulty and style of FAANG coding interviews (800-1600 rating range). Regular practice on AlgoWars directly improves your performance in technical interviews at top companies. START PRACTICING →
